projects.name: (Loan Origination System)
details: • Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to gather, analyze, and validate
end-to-end requirements, resulting in a 35% improvement in requirement clarity and delivery speed.
• Conduct requirement elicitation sessions (interviews, JAD sessions, workshops) with cross-functional
teams (Credit, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT), reducing requirement gaps by 30%.
• Create and maintain critical BA artifacts including:
• BRD and FRD for all loan processing modules, reducing functional ambiguity by 40%
• Use Case Diagrams and Process Flows (Lucidchart / Draw.io)
• 100+ detailed User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria in JIRA, enabling smooth sprint execution
• Define and manage epics, user stories, and sprint backlog items, supporting timely delivery of 12+
sprints with 95% adherence to sprint goals.
• Perform gap analysis and impact assessment across modules like loan application, credit check,
document upload, approval, disbursement, and closure, leading to 20% faster loan processing time.
• Collaborate with UI/UX teams to design 30+ intuitive wireframes and screen mockups, enhancing
customer experience and reducing form abandonment by 25%.
• Document API integration requirements for services like CIBIL, Aadhaar eKYC, PAN verification, and
integration with Core Banking System (CBS)—resulting in 90% process automation for KYC and credit
evaluation.
• Support data mapping and interface design with DMS and LMS, reducing manual effort by 40% and
increasing data accuracy by 30%.
• Coordinate with QA for test case validation, UAT support, and defect triaging, contributing to 98%
test coverage and successful Go-Live with zero critical issues.
• Present status updates, risk logs, and sprint reports to stakeholders, contributing to on-time delivery
of MVP within 4 months.

projects.name: Customization & Client Delivery Optimization
details: • Lead client workshops to elicit, analyse, and validate business requirements, ensuring seamless
customization and successful end-to-end implementation of enterprise applications.
• Act as the primary liaison for managing client change requests, documenting enhancements, and
prioritizing backlog items using Moscow and business value frameworks.
• Prepare and maintain detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement
Documents (FRD) to ensure traceability and alignment with business goals.
• Collaborate with development and QA teams to translate requirements into user stories, define
acceptance criteria, and ensure smooth sprint execution.
• Manage and track defects in JIRA, ensuring timely resolution, validated fixes, and consistent delivery
of high-quality product functionality.
• Conduct functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm readiness for production
release, minimizing post-deployment issues.
• Lead triage efforts during critical production downtimes, coordinating across Technology, QA, and
Professional Services teams to ensure rapid issue resolution and maintain business continuity.
• Deliver client training sessions and knowledge-sharing programs to drive adoption, enhance user
experience, and maximize application value realization.
